modelVersion._description: The model version identifier (IP-unified-architecture §10). MAJOR = structural change (a law, a divisor set, H). MINOR = refit (coefficients move, structure does not). Deliberately OUTSIDE model-parameters.json: a version label must not change the model's content identity (CONSTANTS_HASH). Seeded at v10.0 continuing the repo's existing v9/v10 tag lineage (owner decision); MAJOR/MINOR bumps proceed from here under this scheme. Content identity is carried separately by CONSTANTS_HASH (model parameters) and COEFFICIENTS_HASH (the fit) in packages/physics/src/constants/.
